verdict.rationale: Portfolio roll-up is a fair question for a work-management product like monday.com, so the axis applies. However, no evidence documents a portfolio view that aggregates progress across multiple projects or boards. The nearest items are a developer ability to build custom dashboard widgets (a building block), generic claims about spotting progress gaps and automating status reports, and an admin dashboard for agent spend. None of these is the cross-project progress roll-up itself.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can roll up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view
